body.statement: For \((p^{\mathrm G},s^{\mathrm G})\), does the induced known-margin relevant-IV fiber pass exact compatibility and relevance, and is \(\tau\) rigid on that fiber? Using the GEUVADIS audit handle, return either the exact atlas stratum and PN/PS formula with transition-robust uncertainty, or two legal full SCMs with identical \((p^{\mathrm G},m^{\mathrm G})\) and different targets; report model incompatibility separately from nonidentification.
body.justification: The public case study is a high-value falsification target because its bootstrap estimates reach both logical boundaries.
body.gap: The published application assumes the graph and regular conditions but does not certify compatibility, rank/support stratum, or transition-robust coverage.
body.consumer: Researchers interpreting SWAP70-to-SBF2-AS1 attribution receive either a defensible causal number or an explicit nonidentification certificate.
